phase_reference.instructions: Choose a sound phase-reference repair for a bounded scalar plane-wave MZ prototype where two rays arrive at distinct points on one BS2 plane. Keep the engine small and independently testable.
criteria: Transport each arm from its own hit point to a shared point on BS2 using dot(arrival_direction, reference-hit), then combine; test invariance under choice of reference on the BS2 plane.
Compare phases at their distinct hit points unchanged and only tighten numeric tolerance.
Apply an arbitrary half-factor to the path difference without geometric projection.

overlap_gate.instructions: How should offset BS2 hits be reported while avoiding a false physical-overlap claim? The present engine uses a hard 0.02 BU overlap tolerance and no beam waist.
criteria: Keep hard tolerance as a numerical ideal-plane-wave gate for a CPU diagnostic, label it an approximation, and retain Blender/physical validation block until a spatial mode/beam-waist model is tested.

Add an explicit beam-waist and Gaussian overlap model with coherent/incoherent power partition, independently test power conservation and square counterexample, but still do not claim full physical validation.
Treat any offset within 0.02 BU as exact full physical overlap and remove the validation block.
